annotation.evidence_span: unless a deviation is specifically known to be safe
annotation.interpretation_a: The alt-authority must know that a deviation is safe before deviating; otherwise it must carry the same SvcParams as the origin.
annotation.interpretation_b: The origin must know that a deviation is safe, and if so the alt-authority may deviate; otherwise it must carry the same SvcParams.
annotation.justification: The clause lacks a clear constraint on who must be aware of the safety of a deviation, creating an incomplete constraint that can result in materially different implementations.
annotation.missing_information: Who must know that a deviation is safe (alt-authority, origin, or client) is not specified, leading to different implementation behaviours.
